$schema-comment: Compose MD3 parity budgets per twinned example. An example listed here must have a twin registered in e2e/reference (twinFor); the nightly renders the twin on the same emulator and pixel-compares it against the WaterUI capture. 'default' is the strict fallback fraction; recorded budgets are measured divergence plus headroom, blessed under issue #50 — they encode the current WaterUI-vs-MD3 type-scale/text-metric gap and must shrink as the backend aligns, never grow.
